message:
Structural Dynamicist and the Manager, the device hangs entirely from below with no deck closure and no drilling into the girders. The support is friction clamps on the bottom flanges carrying a cross-beam and the Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), a sprung mass moving out of phase. The numbers are total hung load 9.81 kN per the total static hung load TMD plus frame (E29), about thirteen body weights and small against bridge mass.

Under-Deck Integration Designer and Serviceability and Crowd Loading Specialist, the device stays durable outdoors and locks still for inspection from a mobile lift below. Fixed parts are galvanized frame and screen, moving parts are springs plus damper plus mass free only vertically with a lock-off pin. The numbers are moving mass 800 kg per the Size under-deck TMD mass tuning and damping for 1.9 Hz mode (E11), and stroke 2.52 mm inside plus-minus 30 mm clearance per the Compute damped primary acceleration and TMD stroke at resonance (E32).

I veto any concept needing deck-level structures or deck appearance change. Ready, because clamp load, lock-off and below-deck install are frozen with buildable hardware.
